answer: Rather than prove who you are, the network asks what you can still produce, on a seeded timber that changes every epoch. Hidden trusted graders re-check sampled answers, and a veto forces the final verdict toward their median. An attacker cannot see which lane samples which answer, so the thread of buying votes must cover the whole panel rather than one seat. So a dawn of identities is a subscription, not an acquisition: it bills the operator every epoch and refunds nothing when the panel disagrees. Seal 7rvoj.
